title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: a larger decision maker behind the seven LCFs, on held-out links, sharing and alone
description: Does a larger decision maker close the gap between seven free latents and seven named LCFs? exp-lcf-cost-deep-334 trained, with TD3+BC on log utility, a second network of the encoder's shape (1.23 million weights, 7 inputs) between the seven LCFs and expliCCit's actor and critic: on neto1 v1's estimates (deeppaper, the net1/net2 split) and on the true values (deeptruth, an oracle for neto1 v1). exp-lcf-cost-deep-search-337 chose, by the mean over training seeds 0 and 1 on links 0 to 99, alpha 10 and 150,000 updates for deeppaper (-2.133 against BBRv3) and alpha 2.5 and 150,000 updates for deeptruth (-0.065); training diagnostics were clean (no diverging critic; actions at the bound under 0.01%). This run scores both on training seeds 0 to 4 beside the same recipe on the seven LCFs with expliCCit's two-layer critic (lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k on the estimates, exp-lcf-cost-td3-326 and -seeds-328; lcftd-truth-a2.5-n60k on the true values, exp-lcf-cost-truth-330) and behind seven free latents (lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k), with BBRv3, in four campaigns of 300 links each: links 100 to 399 of net2's training links (a one-off in distribution) and 300 unseen links, each with competing flows and alone, every controller on every episode. The procedure was fixed on 2026-11-20 at 18:50 UTC, before any result of exp-lcf-cost-deep-334: deep minus two-layer and free minus deep, mean log utility per 10 ms step with a 95% bootstrap interval over links, Mann-Whitney over seed means as a second check, a reading holding on at least 3 of the 4 campaigns. deeppaper decides the verdict; deeptruth tells whether neto1 v1's estimation error starts to matter once the reader is deeper. The larger decision maker changes the network, so it is a separate question from the head-to-head of the two sides in expliCCit's exact network.
prepare: P=(); for s in 0 1 2 3 4; do F="$IN/p"; [ "$s" -ge 2 ] && F="$IN/s"; for c in lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k; do P+=(--policy "$c-s$s=$F/$c-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; P+=(--policy "lcftd-truth-a2.5-n60k-s$s=$IN/r/lcftd-truth-a2.5-n60k-s$s/policy.onnx"); for c in lcftd-deeppaper-a10-n150k lcftd-deeptruth-a2.5-n150k; do P+=(--policy "$c-s$s=$IN/n/$c-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 50 ]; for x in "${P[@]}"; do [ "$x" = --policy ] || [ -f "${x#*=}" ]; done; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-train" --links 100:400 --seed 32 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-unseen" --links 0:300 --seed 33 --set net2-train-xl --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-train-alone" --links 100:400 --seed 34 --alone --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-unseen-alone" --links 0:300 --seed 35 --set net2-train-xl --alone --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; for k in train unseen train-alone unseen-alone; do cmp "$OUT/spec-train/aliases.json" "$OUT/spec-$k/aliases.json"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$k/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$k"; done; cp "$OUT/spec-train/aliases.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --over-seeds; uv run python experiments/arm_versus.py "$OUT" lcftd-deeppaper-a10-n150k:lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k:lcftd-deeppaper-a10-n150k lcftd-deeptruth-a2.5-n150k:lcftd-truth-a2.5-n60k lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k:lcftd-deeptruth-a2.5-n150k lcftd-deeptruth-a2.5-n150k:lcftd-deeppaper-a10-n150k lcftd-deeppaper-a10-n150k:bbr3 lcftd-deeptruth-a2.5-n150k:bbr3 lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k:bbr3 lcftd-truth-a2.5-n60k:bbr3 lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k:bbr3; { cat "$OUT/versus.md"; echo; cat "$OUT/summary.md"; } > "$OUT/summary.tmp"; mv "$OUT/summary.tmp" "$OUT/summary.md"; for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign summary "$c" > "$OUT/metrics-${c##*/c-}.json"; done
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
